runpicker.badModel: Type a Claude model id. It starts with claude-, for example claude-opus-5-5.

runpicker.effortHint: Higher effort thinks longer and costs more.
runpicker.ultracodeNotice: Starts helper agents that work in parallel. Costs more.

runpicker.section.name: Model picker
runpicker.section.title: Model, effort and ultracode in New run
